notes: Only the YuNet detector (MIT) is bundled; all other weights are user-supplied. sha256 stays null until the artifact is audited (docs/LICENSE_REVIEW.md). User files go in %LOCALAPPDATA%\AvatarLive\models\.

models.purpose: Face bounding box and 5 landmarks for alignment and tracking.
models.notes: Bundled with the engine (MIT, Copyright (c) 2020 Shiqi Yu). A copy in %LOCALAPPDATA%\\AvatarLive\\models\\ takes precedence; it must match the pinned sha256.

models.license: user-supplied; InsightFace pretrained weights are non-commercial research only
models.purpose: Identity embedding of the source photo (computed once per profile), input 112x112 aligned.
models.notes: Placeholder. User must supply a model whose license permits their use and acknowledge it in the app.
models.user_hint: Copy InsightFace's w600k_r50.onnx (from the buffalo_l pack) here (recognition.onnx is also accepted), then press 'Confirm model licenses' in the Avatar Live source.

models.license: user-supplied; InsightFace inswapper_128 is non-commercial research only
models.purpose: Swap the aligned 128x128 target face using the source identity latent.
models.notes: Flagged non-commercial (InsightFace). FP32 is preferred on CPU; do not assume FP16 is optimal. Not usable for public/commercial releases without a separate license (strategy B/C). FP16 (inswapper_128_fp16.onnx) is accepted and can be faster on GPUs (DirectML); FP32 is usually faster on CPU. If several are present, swapper.onnx, then inswapper_128.onnx, then the FP16 file is used.
models.user_hint: Copy inswapper_128.onnx (FP32, not the fp16 file) here (swapper.onnx is also accepted), then press 'Confirm model licenses' in the Avatar Live source.

models.license: user-supplied; weights trained by the user. DeepFaceLab/DeepFaceLive code is GPL-3.0 (not included)
models.purpose: Face model trained on one specific face; replaces the webcam face without a source photo.
models.notes: Selected by path in the source properties (inference.swap_model = dfm). Requires the user's confirmation that the model depicts them or a consenting person. Input in_face:0 NHWC BGR [0,1]; outputs out_face_mask:0, out_celeb_face:0, out_celeb_face_mask:0; optional morph_value:0.
